summary: Bug Fix Verification Complete - All 6 reported bugs tested and verified as FIXED. 100% backend tests passed (14/14). Frontend UI verified via Playwright showing all fixes working correctly.

issues: Sidebar hover overlay (z-index: 100) intercepts click events - workaround: use direct URL navigation. Does not affect user experience.

critical_code_review_comments: All 6 bugs have been properly fixed
Data import logic correctly classifies vendite (Scarico+VENDITA) vs acquisti (Carico+C/ACQUISTO)
Negative values converted to absolute values
Reference date for inactive clients uses latest DB date instead of datetime.now()
context_for_next_testing_agent: All bug fixes verified working. Data contains July-December 2024 sales with positive totals. Alerts system correctly calculates inactive client days from DB reference date (2024-12-31).

Bug1_VenditeClassification.evidence: GET /api/vendite returns records with Movimento='Scarico' and Causale='VENDITA'. Logic correctly checks both fields.

Bug2_Missing2024Data.evidence: Vendite page shows dates 31/12/2024 and API returns data for 2024-07 through 2024-12.

Bug3_NegativeTotals.evidence: All vendite totals are positive (20,25€, 343,60€, 35.961,24€ etc). Backend uses abs() on import.

Bug4_StatisticheCharts.evidence: Charts show correct 2024 monthly data. totaleEuro=910,925€, monthly trend visible from July-December 2024.

Bug5_PieChartTooltip.evidence: Pie chart tooltip displays client name and amount on hover (e.g., 'NUOVA ORTOFRUTTICOLA MODENESE S.R.L. - 54.650,00 €'). isAnimationActive=false applied.

Bug6_ClientiInattiviDays.evidence: Dashboard shows giorni_inattivo correctly (33gg, 32gg, 62gg, 55gg, 75gg). Days calculated from latest DB date (2024-12-31) not datetime.now().

Bug7_InEsaurimentoGiorni.evidence: In Esaurimento section shows giorni_rimanenti (3gg, 5gg, 12gg, 14gg) based on consumption rate.
